title: Government getting ahead of service members ready to disclose

tellings.quote: And so many service people were on the verge of saying, "I can't not tell them what I saw."

plain: The US government began talking about UFOs because so many service members were on the verge of saying, "I can't not tell them what I saw," and officials wanted to get ahead of them. The economist Tyler Cowen offers this as his reading of events, passing on what he has heard. If so, the openness came from pressure inside the ranks rather than a free choice.
